purpose: gnssl9b (kernel q10jr9 / 0362, ioctl 164 = ladder K=24 V9 HOLD): multi-frame replay of libmnl's DSP code download (_BootDSP_UART_V2, found with n2mnld/mnl_emu2.py: runs/bootdsp_replay.json). The tool is gpu/hwcodec/gnss/probe/n2gpsdl_replay.c (installed under the n2gpsdl_step name so guest/owned/undo are unchanged). After 90 s: V9 HOLD (steps 1..17 + MCUB RESET_DONE ack, EMI_REQ_GPS, USRT INTEN, RX DMA2 armed; /dev/gpsdl0 = byte pipe), 200 ms read, then --boot: header 0xFE08 (expect DSP ack 0xFE31 seq 0; else COMD4 x3 + header, up to 5 rounds), 50 code fragments 0xFE0C of the embedded MT6893_E1 L1 DSP blob each waiting 300 ms for ack 0xFE32 seq k (2 resends), then the post-boot command 0xFE05 (old frame 1) and 3 s read. Every received byte hex-printed and parsed (N2GRPL frame ...). GNSS stays powered until reboot (HOLD). Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
